tweet.text:
Mercury 3 is live: the most capable diffusion LLM released to date.

It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 across a range of benchmarks while running at over 1,000 tokens per second.

More than 40x the size of Mercury 1, 3x more intelligent across standard benchmarks, and just as fast, with a 1M-token context window.

Available today on the Inception API, @baseten, and @OpenRouter .
